definition: HDP = Hidden-state Dependent Plasticity: the general plasticity abstraction. H contains hidden/history/state variables required by a plasticity rule; Theta denotes modifiable parameters. General form: dTheta = P(H,X,Theta). A named mechanism specifies (1) required hidden variables in H, (2) their dynamics, (3) the plasticity equation P, (4) the modified parameter/effective gain.
canonical_rule: Any custom plasticity rule: add its dependent state variables to H, then add its plasticity equation to HDP. Do not create a conceptually separate plasticity engine merely because a rule has a conventional name.
inclusion: HDP superset {STDP, STP, homeostatic plasticity, ...} when representable through the generic framework.

examples.STDP: H_STDP=(H_pre,H_post) decaying spike-history variables; dW=P_STDP(H_pre,H_post,W). STDP is a special case of HDP when its variables/equation are represented through H/HDP. (JaxFNE 0.4.22: STDP traces exist only in non-canonical streaming runner, unwired from simulate(). See hdp_expressivity_audit.json.)
examples.stp_facilitation_depression: A short-term efficacy rule is an HDP special case IF its required variables/update equations are represented through H and HDP (fast event-driven traces + bounded efficacy target). Absent from 0.4.22 canonical surface. Extension required, not a separate engine.
examples.homeostatic_plasticity: The previously qualified Jomission H-dependent homeostatic controller (eta=4, H-dependent allocation, state-dependent retention) is ONE specific HDP configuration. Qualified holdings stand; detachment until reattachment gate stands.

sealed_strings_reading: Historical executed artifacts containing HDP OFF / HDP off / K_HDP=0.0 (results JSON, code comments, session docs) are NOT rewritten. Under the corrected definition they read as: the qualified homeostatic HDP configuration disengaged (enable_hdp=False / K_HDP=0, static synapses); the generic H/Theta framework untouched. Scientific content (matched controls with static synapses) unchanged.
constitutive_exception: The detachment rule (qualified homeostatic HDP configuration must not manufacture recurrent-substrate success before its reattachment gate) does NOT prohibit a different H-based plasticity mechanism constitutive to the substrate being tested. Such a mechanism enters through the substrate gate with its own configured-to-realized-to-effective qualification, not through HDP reattachment.
supersedes_phrasing: Missing native STP capability is superseded as blocker phrasing by: No qualified native realization of the required state-dependent recurrent-efficacy transformation has yet been demonstrated. (Audit verdict HDP_EXTENSION_REQUIRED.)
